$comment: How much each gate looked at, last time it passed. A FALL fails `run-all-gates`: a walk that covers fewer subjects than before is the failure that prints a tick. Re-record with `npm run gates:record` when the drop is intended, and say why in the commit.
$measuredBy: a full run of every gate. Read `$units` before comparing any number here to a new one: fall-detection compares integers and cannot see that a gate has changed WHAT it counts.

$units.demo-coverage: library-authored props across the public surface
$units.fixture-gap: props rendering markup no fixture produces (a FLOOR, not a total; see 002-fixture-gap.json)
$units.unit+contracts: tests collected by vitest across all projects
$units.e2e:a11y-full: tests collected across the a11y-full project's specs (accessibility-full, contrast-painted, default-state). It read "axe rule-sets run" until 2026-10-20, which is not what `/collected (\d+)/` counts: the 12 recorded on 2026-10-01 was 2 + 4 + 6 tests in those three specs.
$units.e2e:visual: visual subjects photographed (subject x theme x width)
$units.e2e:demo-contrast: demo PAGES walked, NOT colour pairs measured. It was keyed to rows until 2026-09-12 and read 41289/41429/41445/41461/41585 on consecutive green runs, because the dropdown pages fetch country lists and the row count moves with network timing. Pages is the coverage figure; rows never were one. Do not compare any number here to a row count.
$units.e2e:rest: tests collected across the specs no other gate claims (49 on 2026-10-20, 32 when this was first recorded; run-all-gates prints the list)
$units.e2e:pointer-affordance: library-rendered elements that act on a click — by a React onClick/onPointerDown read off the node's props, or by an interactive role — excluding dismissal surfaces and disabled controls
$units.demo-scenarios: cells of docs/demo-scenarios.json checked: the 30 public components (from the root barrel) x the 22 scenarios
$units.demo-skeleton: component pages whose top-level order is checked against the skeleton (header > setup > anatomy > examples > reference > patterns > copy and paste); the same run renders each page anatomy against the types

$secondsNote: Wall-clock per gate on a green run, for the slowdown check in run-all-gates. The multiple is DERIVED, not chosen: across green runs the widest healthy spread for one gate was unit+contracts at 88s to 149s, a factor of 1.69, with e2e:demo-contrast at 1.24 and the rest at or under 1.25. Under memory pressure the same gates ran e2e:icon-bounds 436->948 (2.17), e2e:visual 296->926 (3.13), e2e:a11y-full 352->1431 (4.07) and e2e:demo-contrast 70->624 (8.9). So healthy tops out at 1.69 and the mildest pressure observed is 2.17; 2.0 sits between them and is the only round number that does. Gates under 10s are exempt, because 1s to 3s is a factor of three and means nothing.

ratchets.$comment: Counts that may only fall, each checked both ways: a rise fails, and a fall fails until the value here is lowered in the same change — slack left in a ratchet is spent by the next rise without anyone seeing it, the rule the bundle ledger keeps. Never written by --record; lowered by hand, with the reason in the commit.
